summary: Wheaton Precious Metals filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 news release, MD&A and interim financials for the period ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO/CFO certifications. Reported Q3 revenue of $772 million, net earnings of $410 million and operating cash flow of $645 million; nine-month revenue reached a record $2.6 billion. A quarterly dividend of $0.195 per share was declared, with $89 million paid. Net debt stood at $1.5 billion after repaying $372 million on the revolver. No transaction, tender, activist or structural event is disclosed; watch production guidance delivery and growth-project milestones.
